title: confed mv result
description: The `result` of `confed mv --json`: the page moved or renamed on disk and, with --push, on the server too. Without --push the next `confed push` carries the move.

to.description: Workspace-relative path after it. The same as `from` for a reorder with no destination.

title_changed.description: The page title follows the new file name (--rename-title).

parent_changed.description: The page now sits under another parent.

pushed.description: --push sent the move to the server. False when there was nothing to send.

reordered.description: --before, --after or --position changed the page's place among its siblings on the server.
